text:
Priya: Quick question — partner metering edgecase: when a partner sends a usage event with no entitlement_id (legacy SI payload), do we dead-letter or try to map by customer email?
Marco: Ideally map by external_customer_id -> entitlement lookup, but only if confidence==1. Otherwise DLQ.
Alex: This came up in yesterday's call with EdgeWave. They have a 3rd party aggregator that strips entitlement in some batches.
Li: Can we do a best-effort enrichment pipeline? e.g., lookup by subscription_token then attach entitlement_id and re-ingest.
Marco: We could attempt enrichment but mustn't double-charge. Need idempotency key check before accepting enriched event.
Priya: What should DLQ retention be? Partner asked to keep for 30 days.
Kara: Legal prefers 90 days for audit requests, but Ops retention costs matter. Can we keep metadata for 90d and raw payload 30d?
Alex: Partner asks for a replay endpoint as part of contract. We should define SLA: 48h replay window for nearline batches, >48h go to manual support.
Marco: Implementation notes: we can route unmapped events to s3://redwood-partner-dlq/{partner}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}/. Put a manifest+checksum. Automation for retries up to 3x with exponential backoff.
Li: Also add a tagging field: "enriched_by" and "enrichment_trace" with request_id so we can audit who changed what.
Priya: Ok. For entitlement mapping rules let's capture priority: 1) entitlement_id in payload, 2) external_customer_id -> entitlement, 3) subscription_token -> entitlement, 4) fallback to partner-provided mapping file.
Marco: Edgecases: if mapping yields multiple entitlements (one customer across orgs) we should DLQ and flag for manual review.
Priya: Agreed. Also need to firm up monitor & alerting. Who owns SLO for DLQ growth?
Alex: Partnerships will triage initial spikes but platform should own automated alerting. Set alert: DLQ count > 0.5% of daily ingest for 3 consecutive hours -> page eng oncall.
ingest-bot: [ingest-bot] New DLQ batch written: s3://redwood-partner-dlq/edgewave/2026/03/23/part-0007.json (size=12KB, count=42)
Marco: Thanks bot. Can we standardize DLQ schema: original_event, reason_code, processing_step, timestamp, partner_headers. Keeps it simple.
Kara: Add legal tag if PII present so we don't auto-delete until review.
Li: I'll add a small lambda to run enrichment for common patterns (email->entitlement) but will only mark event as accepted after idempotency check against ledger.
Priya: Action items: Marco to draft DLQ schema + retention policy, Li to prototype enrichment lambda, Alex to update partner contract language for replay window, Kara to confirm legal retention constraints.
Alex: Target to have draft by EOD Friday. I'll coordinate with EdgeWave to sign off on replay SLA. :thumbsup:
Marco: I'll post the schema in #eng-platform when done.
Priya: Thanks everyone — looping in here so we have a record.
Alex: tagging @EdgeWave contact for awareness (not in this channel)
Priya: marking this resolved for now, will follow up once drafts exist.
